description: Used a ref_id from a filtered tree on an unfiltered turn (or vice versa).

antiPatterns.reason: ref_5 was from the filtered tree; we last requested filter:"all".

expected.successRubric: Use the ref_id from the MOST RECENT tree call. Different filters produce different ref_id allocations.

content:
The previous attempt to click the second button failed because the ref_id was not found in the current accessibility tree. The page content shows two buttons: "First" [ref_2] and "Second" [ref_5]. However, when I tried to click ref_5, it wasn't found.

Let me try clicking the button by its visible text instead. The page has a "button \"Second\" [ref_5]" element. I can try clicking it with the text "Second" or by its visible text.

Actually, looking at the available tools, I can use `click_ax` with a CSS selector. The selector for the second button would be `button "Second"`.

Let me try that approach.</think><|tool_call_start|>[click_ax(selector='button "Second"')]<|tool_call_end|>
